$comment: F2 · the default-fund register (קרנות פנסיה נבחרות / ברירת מחדל), hand-curated. Every fact carries `src` (indices into sources[]) and `ver`: primary = read on the regulator's own document (gov.il PDF, page pg); issuer = the winning company's own TASE filing quoting the regulator's award notice; press = reported by the press only, the regulator's notice not found; derived = follows from a primary rule (e.g. the end of a period from the next determining date). Nothing is inferred beyond that: a figure no source prints is left out. `pid` = the fund's id in pensia-net (PARENT_COMPANY_ID) and is the site's mapping, labelled `map`: the regulator's files carry today's fund names on their whole history, so a winner is matched to the fund id whose tracks bore its name (inferred, stated in `map_note`). pipeline/build_fund_stats.py reads this file and writes web/public/data/funds/default.json.
